legend: Default legend of the two radio cards that choose who sees a Space, in the new Space dialog. "Space" is a product noun (a shared area of pages).
whole.title: Radio card: the Space is open to everyone in the workspace.
whole.detail: Under the Whole workspace choice. The _member form is shown to people who aren't workspace admins, who can't pick it.
private.title: Radio card: only the people added to the Space see it.
private.detail: Under the Only its people choice. "Socios" are AI agents. The list of what a private Space covers matches the Space's other audience texts.
